review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature foot part (PROPOSED): an elephant's pillar foot, a wide wrinkled column on a thick padded sole with five broad rounded toenails round the front.

textures.name: T_PartFootPillar_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartFootPillar_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the base up to 25% wider, most at the sole
the toenails 35% bigger and standing out further

part_rules.handles_note: H1_Wide is on FootPillar, FootPillarSole and FootPillarNails (the sole and nails ride on the widening base); H2_Nails is on FootPillarNails only.
part_rules.pivot_note: Ground part: the sole sits on the pivot; the column is 0.05 m across at the ankle (z 0.09 m), where the limb tip meets it, and closes over its top in a shoulder inside the limb.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a wide round column (0.145 x 0.16 m, slightly longer front to back) flaring to a thick padded sole with a rounded rim, the toes' swellings round the front base under five broad half-moon toenails that rest on the sole's rim, a rounded shoulder closing over the top inside the limb. H1_Wide spreads the base (sole and nails ride on it), H2_Nails enlarges the nails; neither tears. In a scratch geometry preview the first draft's nails were round coins halfway up the column; the first build's sole shared the column's mesh and its material border decimated into a sawtooth of dark triangles (mat_side), so the sole is now its own closed mesh tucked inside the column and the border is a clean intersection line.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: three finishes - matt grey skin with wavy horizontal creases over a fine cracked grid, a dark rubbery sole band with crack lines, ivory nails with horizontal growth lines and a soft sheen.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the grazing light shows the creases and the toe swellings, the sole band stays dark without crushing, the nails bright without clipping.
review_notes.gate4_godot: needs revision: editor floor only, shared by every foot (not this art): the editor's floor disc sits at the body's bounds while the resolver stands every ground part 0.09 x scale below its limb tip, so the lowest few centimetres of every foot (existing ones too) sink through the floor in the editor; in the world the walker lifts each tip by that height and the soles stand on the ground. On the tortoise (both feet swapped in memory, after_tortoise_foot_pillar.jpg) the feet load, sit on the limb tips at the column's width with the nails toward the head, but the soles are 4.5 cm under the floor, hiding the sole band and the toenails, so the feet read as plain wrinkled stumps. With the floor lowered to the soles (review-only --floor-at-soles, soles_tortoise_foot_pillar.jpg) they read as elephant feet from every view: wrinkled grey columns, ivory toenails round the front, a dark sole at the base; the nails show as pale dots even at the world camera's distance.

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
